# Exxonim Consult

> Exxonim Consult is a Tanzanian business consultancy that takes a client from
> first inquiry through company registration, licensing, and ongoing compliance.
> Services include company registration, TIN, business licensing, work permits,
> NGO registration, statutory filing, and annual returns. Clients track their
> case by number on the public site and are notified through their chosen channel.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://consult.exxonim.tz/): Overview of Exxonim Consult's business setup and compliance services in Tanzania.
- [Services](https://consult.exxonim.tz/services/): Full list of services — company registration, TIN, licensing, work permits, NGO registration, statutory filing, and annual returns.
- [Track a consultation](https://consult.exxonim.tz/track-consultation/): Follow the status of a case by its tracking number, with notifications by the client's chosen channel.
- [About](https://consult.exxonim.tz/about/): Who Exxonim Consult is and how the firm works.
- [Resources](https://consult.exxonim.tz/resources/): Articles and guides on registration, compliance, and doing business in Tanzania.
- [FAQ](https://consult.exxonim.tz/faq/): Answers to common questions about registration, timelines, and requirements.
- [Contact](https://consult.exxonim.tz/contact/): Get in touch or start a new engagement.
- [Careers](https://consult.exxonim.tz/career/): Open roles at Exxonim Consult.
